issues.location: hooks/session-start:377 and hooks/trivial-file-guard.sh:84 (caused by hooks/lib/runtime-paths.sh canonical containment, commit 6726c0f)
issues.problem: Coverage regression outside the new code. The only tests that exercised the symlink reset statements '[[ -L "$trivial_file" ]] && trivial_file=<default>' configure a trivial_file that is a symlink pointing OUTSIDE the state root (tests/hooks/test-session-start-paths.sh:169-175, tests/hooks/test-trivial-file-guard-paths.sh:62-66). With the old string-prefix predicate that path was accepted and then reset by the -L line; with canonical containment it is rejected one line earlier, so the -L reset never executes in any test. The reset is still reachable (default marker symlinked, or a configured in-root link), but no test covers it, so the CI full coverage run (--fail-under 100) will fail for both files. The round-1 coverage runs did not include session-start or trivial-file-guard.sh.
issues.evidence: Scoped coverage (REVF-F1c-probe/cov, 25 test files incl. every test-session-start*.sh, test-symlink-guard, test-state-path-containment, test-branch-scope): hooks/session-start 437/444, missing 377(=) (other missing lines 153, 239, 240, 368, 495, 503 are pre-existing and belong to suites outside the run: recommended-tools, non-git runs, config-walk-vanishes, enterprise-policy). xtrace probe scripts/p11d.sh: scenario of test-session-start-paths (cfg trivial -> link to outside) -> BASE reset executed=1, FIXED=0; default-marker-link and in-root-link scenarios -> FIXED=1 (reachable). scripts/p12-tfg.sh with the test-trivial-file-guard-paths scenario: 'BASE symlink-reset(line 84) executed=1', 'FIXED executed=0'. grep: no other test creates a symlinked trivial marker and runs session-start or trivial-file-guard.sh (c-toolgates helpers run the tool-gate hooks only).
issues.suggested_fix: Point the two existing symlink tests at an in-root target (ln -s "$SD/inner" "$SD/linked-trivial" / "$SD/linked-marker") and/or add a case where the default marker "$SD/trivial" is a symlink to an outside file (assert the target is untouched and the link is removed / the marker write still blocked); keep the outside-target case as well. Then run one scoped coverage run with --only hooks/session-start --only hooks/trivial-file-guard.sh over their suites. Consider grepping for other '-L ... && reset' or symlink-only branches after sb_runtime_path_is_state_scoped (none other found in hooks/).

issues.problem: R1-29 recovery path is still closed for array-shaped shell payloads (tool_input.command = ["bash","-lc",CMD], the Codex/Kay shape the repo's own tests use: tests/hooks/test-dev-cycle-check.sh:142, test-completion-audit.sh:340, test-kay-project-hook-bridge.sh:115). The field reader shlex-joins the list to "bash -lc 'brew install jq'", which never matches the remediation regex; read-only commands still pass only because sb_shell_command_looks_read_only unwraps bash -lc. Not a regression (base blocked everything), but the 'install jq is always allowed' promise does not hold on that host shape.
issues.evidence: scripts/p8-codex-nojq.sh (PATH without jq, SILVER_BULLET_RUNTIME=codex): arr 'brew install jq' -> dev-cycle-check DENY, planning-file-guard DENY, workflow-chain-guard DENY; arr 'sudo apt-get install -y jq' -> same 3 DENY; str forms allowed; arr 'ls -la', 'git status', 'jq --version' allowed.
issues.suggested_fix: In _sb_jq_payload_field, when the command is a list of the form [sh|bash|zsh, -c|-lc|-lic, SCRIPT] return SCRIPT (or unwrap the same way command_looks_read_only.py does) before matching; add array-shape cases to test-jq-gate.sh.

issues.problem: The env-prefix part of round-1 issue 3 is fixed, but the generic flag pattern ([-A-Za-z0-9=]+) still admits package-manager options that load configuration, plugins or hooks from a file in the project, and one full system upgrade, so repo-controlled code can still run while the gates are degraded (needs a pre-existing dot-free file/dir in the project and usually sudo/root).
issues.evidence: scripts/regex.sh (default and BASH_COMPAT=32): ALLOWED 'sudo apt-get --config-file=evil install -y jq', 'sudo apt-get -c=evil install jq', 'sudo dnf --setopt=pluginpath=evil --setopt=pluginconfpath=evil install -y jq', 'sudo yum --config=evil install jq', 'sudo pacman -S --hookdir=evil jq', 'sudo pacman -S --config=evil jq', 'apk add --repositories-file=evil jq', 'nix-env -iA nixpkgs.jq --file=evil', 'sudo zypper --root=evil install jq', 'conda install -c=evil jq', and 'sudo pacman -Syu jq' (full upgrade, the reason dnf update was dropped). Minor false positive: 'DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive sudo apt-get install -y jq' denied.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the free-form flag pattern with an allowlist of value-less flags (-y, --yes, --assume-yes, -q, --quiet, --noconfirm, --needed, --no-install-recommends, -E, --) and reject any '=' flag; restrict pacman to -S/-Sy (no -u). Add negative tests for the cases above.

issues.problem: The new prefix/suffix loop is correct (round-trips under every compat level) but O(n x occurrences): each replacement rescans the remaining string, 33 passes per string. Today only short static jq-missing messages reach the Bash encoder (callers with dynamic text exit earlier without jq), so there is no practical impact, but a long message with many newlines/quotes would exceed hook timeouts on a jq-less, python3-less machine.
issues.evidence: scripts/enc-perf.sh, same inputs, old (eadf8bd) vs new encoder: mix 2 KB 8 -> 186 ms, 10 KB 74 -> 1072 ms, 40 KB 128 -> 20202 ms; nl 40 KB 42 -> 2098 ms; plain text stays linear. Note the round-1 suggested unquoted form (s=${s//"$bs"/$r}) is NOT a valid alternative on Bash 5.2: patsub_replacement eats the backslashes (scripts/enc-linear.sh: 'Invalid \escape' under default and BASH_COMPAT=32); with 'shopt -u patsub_replacement 2>/dev/null' it round-trips under default/32/42 and encodes 40 KB mixed in 64-100 ms.
issues.suggested_fix: Either document the quadratic bound next to the function (inputs are short static messages) or use single-pass replacement with patsub_replacement disabled (and restored) inside the function; keep the BASH_COMPAT=32/42 round-trip tests.

issues.problem: The new session-start spelling loop is weaker than its comment: it says a branch switch is detected but never starts a second session on another branch; the case labelled trailing-slash in the report is actually '$SD/branch-slash/x/..' (no trailing '/' case); and 'stored' cats $SD/branch too, so a session-start that ignored a valid override and wrote the default would still pass the 'branch recorded' assertion (only the warning assertion catches today's mutation).
issues.evidence: Mutation M1 (eadf8bd session-start) is caught only by the three 'no write-failure warning' assertions (35 passed/3 failed); the 'branch recorded for ...' assertions pass on the mutant.
issues.suggested_fix: Assert the exact resolved file per spelling (not the default), add a '$SD/branch-trailing/' case, and add a checkout + second start asserting 'git scope changed'.

issues.problem: Contract text says status 1 only when provably outside, but an empty target returns 1 (a deny guard fed an unparsed/empty path allows), and a loop anywhere in ROOT makes every path 'inside'. No callers exist yet (only tests), so this only affects the API offered to G2.
issues.evidence: tests/hooks/test-path-canonical.sh pins within 'empty target' 1 and 'loop in the root counts as inside' 0; grep finds no non-test caller of sb_path_is_within.
issues.suggested_fix: Document both edge cases in the header (callers must treat an empty or unparsable target as deny themselves).
